content:
Column addition with carry \(c\in\{0,1\}\) from the units column:

\[
\begin{array}{c@{\;}c@{\;}c}
 & A & B\\
+ & A & A\\
\hline
1 & 6 & 2
\end{array}
\]

Units column:
\[
A+B=2+cd.
\]

Next column, carry to \(d^2\) is \(1\):
\[
2A+c=d+6.
\]

If \(c=0\), then \(2A=d+6\), so \(d=2A-6>6\Rightarrow A>6\). But units gives \(A+B=2\Rightarrow A\le 2\), contradiction.

Thus \(c=1\). Then
\[
2A+1=d+6 \Rightarrow d=2A-5.
\]
Units:
\[
A+B=d+2=(2A-5)+2=2A-3,
\]
so
\[
B=A-3.
\]
Therefore
\[
A-B=3.
\]

\[
\boxed{3_d}
\]
